method.ratio: ratio of independently measured medians; faster FP32 control selected for each task/thread/batch/sorting/metric
method.scope: warm serial CPU execution; identical inputs and truncation; original FP32 also uses ORT_ENABLE_ALL
method.variability: all-samples ordering is descriptive and is not a confidence interval; this small serial repeat count does not establish production tail latency
method.precision: compact variants are lossy INT8/UINT8, with dynamic quantization sensitive to batch composition; relevance quality is measured separately
method.sizes: model file bytes only; no resident-RAM or energy claim

ort_only_seconds.interpretation: descriptive range flag, not a confidence interval or outlier-exclusion rule; all samples retained; cause of variability not identified

prepared_pipeline_seconds.interpretation: descriptive range flag, not a confidence interval or outlier-exclusion rule; all samples retained; cause of variability not identified
